ja: • 手のひらサイズで精密なディテールのメカコレクションのウルトラマンシリーズにウルトラセブンに登場のハイドランジャーが登場！
• 手のひらサイズながらハイドランジャーの特徴の船体の窓まで精密に再現！
• 魚雷は選択式で有り無しどちらも楽しめる！1号、2号両方のマーキングが付属し2隻とも再現可能！
en: • The Hydranger from Ultra Seven is now available in the Ultraman series, a palm-sized mechanical collection with precise details!
• Although it is palm-sized, it accurately reproduces Hydranger's characteristic hull windows!
• You can choose between torpedoes and enjoy them with or without torpedoes! Markings for both No. 1 and No. 2 are included and both ships can be reproduced!
